card.title: Give your AI agent a wallet.

segments.text: Give your AI agent a wallet. With your rules.
Search thousands of paid services, with the price on every network.
It pays on its own, up to the limit you set.
Above it, you approve with one tap. No answer, no payment.
Every signature is checked for scams first. A red verdict is never signed.
And every purchase gets a receipt in plain words.
